name: 문체 계량 분석
description: 분석합니다 문체 특징 감지하기 위해 AI 생성 text through stylistic fingerprinting.
useCase: Identifying AI 생성 text 분석하여 문체 characteristics unique to human authors
mechanism: 추출합니다 문체측정 특징 including sentence structure 패턴, 구두점 usage, paragraph organization, rhetorical devices, and 담화 표지. Human writing exhibits consistent personal style signatures, while AI text shows characteristic 패턴 of the generating model — often more formal, structured, and lacking personal quirks.
source: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
algorithm: Stylometric Feature Extraction + Statistical Pattern Classification + Discourse Analysis
parameters: Features: 50+ stylistic markers, Min length: 200 words, Analysis: n-gram 분포, function 단어 빈도, 가독성 indices
strengths:
• Captures deep 문체 패턴

• Can distinguish 사이의 different AI models

limitations:
• Requires sufficient text length for reliable 분석

• Professional editing can mask style signals
